lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical alignment of three high-intensity circular clusters is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, followed by a secondary column of four smaller clusters; these form the leading edge of a broader, semi-regular 2D grid of spots extending posteriorly across the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a grid-like pattern, with high-luminance circular blobs localized at the nodes where these axes cross.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible along the upper half of the flank, characterized by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal-facing edges to dark shadow on the ventral-facing troughs.
